subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: After the three correctness defects are repaired, should `append` become a permanent optional input on the existing model-facing `write` tool?
rationale: The repair mechanics are clear, but selecting the durable public tool API requires owner intent because agents and integrations may learn and depend on it.

options.title: Approve repaired append input
options.body: Accept the opt-in mode after backend semantics, descriptions, regression coverage, and real proof are consistent.

options.title: Use a distinct append tool
options.body: Keep `write` overwrite-only and expose append separately so policy and behavior remain explicit.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired append input
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in mode after backend semantics, descriptions, regression coverage, and real proof are consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the major agent-runtime refactor and repeated recent ownership of the write and tool-catalog surfaces.
